title: Commissioning illustrations

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Define the illustration’s purpose and future uses before commissioning it so the artwork can serve the intended audience and lifecycle.
strategic_value: Clear briefs and retained originals can help Helsinki reuse coherent illustration across teams.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture presents a numbered commissioning questionnaire followed by agreement, modification, original-file and distribution checks.
practical_value: Specify audience, emotional role, quantities, formats, animation needs, lifecycle and deadline, then agree reuse and modification rights.

content_islands.name: Brief questions
content_islands.spec: Keep the twelve purpose, content, production and lifecycle questions in order.

content_islands.name: Commissioning checklist
content_islands.spec: Group rights, modification, originals and sharing conditions below the questionnaire.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text says a good brief supports accurate quotes and avoids misunderstanding or unnecessary work.
reference_purposes.Application: The questions define purpose, audience, style, usage, future animation and lifecycle.
reference_purposes.Constraint: An agreement is required; originals must be delivered and archived; modification permissions should be agreed, with the stated scope excluding additions.
